title: Music and Instruments
summary: Strings, drums and wind instruments control pitch by changing length, tension and the size of the vibrating part. Tune your own jal tarang!

ib.note: Standing waves and harmonics follow in DP

objectives: I can classify instruments as string, percussion or wind, and name the vibrating part.
I can explain how length, tension and thickness change the pitch of a string.
I can explain why adding water changes the pitch of a jal tarang bowl and a blown bottle in opposite ways.
misconceptions: Adding water always raises the pitch.
Tightening a string makes it louder.
